purpose: Research refresh for the 44 additional-country calculator programme. Not calculator input and must not activate this country.

currency.name: Central African CFA franc
currency.note: Use XAF for display and accounting; validate unit conversions, rounding and any regional price reporting before implementation.

primary_agricultural_statistics.publisher: Institut National de la Statistique du Congo (INS-Congo)

production_survey_2024.title: Enquête sur les productions végétales 2024
production_survey_2024.limitation: The portal catalogue confirms the report exists, but the underlying PDF tables were not extracted in this pass. Do not claim its crop tables have been validated.

agriculture_census_2024.title: RGA-Congo 2024 - Résultats préliminaires
agriculture_census_2024.limitation: Preliminary census report listing only; detailed tables and methods remain to be extracted.

related_documents.title: RGA - Rapport sur les exploitations agricoles 2022
Statistiques des productions animales au Congo 2023

primary_agricultural_statistics.caveat: A publication catalogue is evidence that a source exists, not evidence that its numerical tables have been retrieved or quality-checked.

crop_production_and_seasonality.main_food_crop: Cassava, cultivated through the year in northern and southern areas with seasonal timing depending on rainfall.
crop_production_and_seasonality.maize_2026: Main season harvest completed January 2026 and assessed near average; secondary crop planted through March for July harvest under generally favourable moisture conditions. These are qualitative outlook statements, not yield observations.
crop_production_and_seasonality.quality: National crop output series provide a cross-check only. No verified department-level area, production and yield table was extracted. Do not use the 2026 cereal import forecast or qualitative near-average maize statement as farm yield or profit inputs.

provider_claims.markets_claimed: 22+ markets on English public page; French landing page names seven Brazzaville/Pointe-Noire markets

Soko_platform.access_limit: The platform says full prices and 90-day history require a Soko account. Public sample values are dated market-side observations, not verified farmgate producer prices. Provider's coverage and verification claims require independent checks of sample count, grade, transaction level, units and collection methodology.

WFP_secondary_market_snapshot.source: ShelfPedia presentation of WFP market price data
WFP_secondary_market_snapshot.limitation: Secondary presentation of retail market prices for three markets; not a current producer price series and not suitable for crop-revenue assumptions.

INS_consumer_price_indices.limitation: Broad consumer price indices, not commodity prices; cannot be converted to XAF/kg without item-level price observations and base prices.

input_cost_and_enterprise_budget_evidenc.seed_and_planting_material: No verified current farmer-paid price schedule by crop, variety, department and unit extracted.
input_cost_and_enterprise_budget_evidenc.fertilizer_and_soil_amendments: No verified current product prices, application rates or per-hectare costs extracted.
input_cost_and_enterprise_budget_evidenc.crop_protection: No validated pesticide/herbicide product and operation cost schedule extracted.
input_cost_and_enterprise_budget_evidenc.labour: No current department-level agricultural wage schedule or crop-operation labour coefficients validated.
input_cost_and_enterprise_budget_evidenc.machinery_and_land_preparation: No current machinery hire or land-preparation rates validated.
input_cost_and_enterprise_budget_evidenc.irrigation_water_energy: No crop/department-level irrigation, pumping, water or energy cost series extracted.
input_cost_and_enterprise_budget_evidenc.transport_postharvest_packaging: No verified farm-to-market, handling, packaging, storage or post-harvest cost schedule extracted.
input_cost_and_enterprise_budget_evidenc.enterprise_budgets: No complete crop-by-department enterprise budgets with gross margin or net profit validated.

blockers: Download and extract the INS-Congo 2024 plant-production survey and 2024 preliminary agricultural census; record methodology, coverage, department, crop, season, area, output, yield and uncertainty.
Extract and cross-check primary FAOSTAT crop item/element/year observations against INS tables; preserve differences rather than blending series.
Obtain Soko sample export or institutional data access; validate actual market list, date, grade, unit, number of observations and whether each value is retail, wholesale or farmgate.
Acquire producer/farmgate prices by crop, department, season, grade and unit; do not use consumer price indices or retail prices as farm revenue.
Collect current farmer-paid seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, labour, machinery, irrigation/energy, transport and post-harvest costs.
Construct regionally grounded enterprise budgets for the target 17 commodities and create XAF unit, area, yield and profit regression tests.
decision: Republic of the Congo is not calculator-ready. Research refresh only; no activation, merge or deployment.
next_step: Extract INS-Congo's 2024 plant-production survey and preliminary agricultural census, then obtain a verifiable Soko market-price sample and separate farmgate producer quotations before building regional budgets.
